name: Mount Kenya National Park/Natural Forest
description: Mount Kenya is an extinct volcano in central Kenya, and at 5,199 metres it is the second highest peak in Africa. Millions of years of erosion have worn it down from a possible 6,500 metres to rugged summits holding 12 shrinking glaciers. Forested slopes, unusual high-altitude plants and foothills where elephants still roam make it one of East Africa's most striking landscapes.
